description: The largest terminology + feature overhaul in SCP to date: (1) rename every 'tool' to 'outlet' across the Rust core, 4 FFI bridges, 4 SDKs, event log, UCAN stems, canonical hash domain separators, enforcement files, and specs — hard break, no migrations, no aliases (MCP wire boundary keeps 'tool' via a lexical translator in scp-mcp); (2) introduce OutletKind { Query, Action } with structural floor at registration, ReadOnlyInvocation guard at runtime, split UCAN stems (outlet_query:*, outlet_call:*), per-kind chain depth and rate tiers, chain amplification rule (Query→Action forbidden), and a shared operator-signed relay-hosted Query cache; (3) add scoped UCAN invocation caveats — structured typed fields in `nb`, `narrow()` attenuation, conservative JSON Schema narrowing, CaveatCounterStore for rate/cumulative accounting, mint limits, whole-token revocation; (4) replace the lossy boolean/string error path with a structured OutletError envelope carrying 8 root classes, RetryPolicy enum, MessagePack wire tags for forward compat, sealed SDK hierarchies, and cross-context source_chain wrapping — reusing SCP-TOOL-6100-6199 rather than inventing a new prefix that would break check-error-codes.sh; (5) make invocation streaming-native — every call is an OutletStreamOpen + OutletStreamChunk + OutletStreamCredit sequence, ToolResponse eliminated, one MLS message per chunk, credit-based backpressure, Merkle chunk manifest in the event log, SDK idioms per language (AsyncIterator, AsyncIterable, AsyncThrowingStream, Flow). Scope: ~2,300 occurrences across ~172 files.
